Change Analysis Report · United States · Category
Search Demand Report
magnesium supplement
As of 2026-10-12 · 2022-10 – 2026-09 · 570 keywords measured
Background and purpose

If searches for 'magnesium supplement' fell or rose, this report checks whether the whole market moved together or only 'magnesium supplement' differs, and what people search for more or less within it. It compares the last 4 years (48 months) of search volume in 1-year periods using ListeningMind United States (Google) search data.

Magnesium moves with comparable supplements, but its growth comes from ‘magnesium supplements’ (+184.3%), not the larger bare term ‘magnesium’. Inside the category, searches by form, led by magnesium glycinate, now make up most purpose-level searches.

01Market flow comparison
Mineral supplements rose while sleep and stress supplements fell
Zinc (+113.2%), calcium (+130.3%) and iron (+38.8%) grew over four years, while melatonin (−27.8%) and ashwagandha (−32.7%) fell. Because the two groups move in opposite directions, the verdict changes if zinc, iron or calcium is removed.
‘magnesium supplements’ grew while the bare term ‘magnesium’ declined
‘magnesium’ still accounts for 59.6% of the last 12 months but is down −8.1% over four years and −19.3% in the last year. ‘magnesium supplements’ grew +184.3% over the same four years.
Same as marketmagnesium supplement and ashwagandha, zinc, iron, melatonin and others both grew
magnesium supplement 4-year +26.5% · similar category median +21.7% · gap +4.8%p
The supplements market is growing — 4 of 6 compared category groups grew, with a median 4-year change of +21.7%. magnesium supplement moved similarly at +26.5%, so this looks like a market trend rather than something specific to magnesium supplement.

Magnesium glycinate leads and keeps growing
‘magnesium glycinate supplements’ reached 5,058,000 searches in the last 12 months (+120.6% year on year), more than ‘magnesium supplements’ itself. ‘magnesium bisglycinate supplement’ (+118.3%) and ‘magnesium threonate supplement’ (+54.3%) also grew, while ‘magnesium citrate supplement’ fell (−16.2%).
Recommendations · beginners4 years −17.9%#1 → #3
Generic ‘best’ searches are shrinking
‘best magnesium supplements’ fell −27.1% year on year and ‘best form of magnesium supplement’ fell −45.7%, while searches naming a specific form kept growing.

At a glance
Background and purpose

If searches for 'magnesium supplement' fell or rose, this report checks whether the whole market moved together or only 'magnesium supplement' differs, and what people search for more or less within it. It compares the last 4 years (48 months) of search volume in 1-year periods using ListeningMind United States (Google) search data.

Magnesium moves with comparable supplements, but its growth comes from ‘magnesium supplements’ (+184.3%), not the larger bare term ‘magnesium’. Inside the category, searches by form, led by magnesium glycinate, now make up most purpose-level searches.

Analysis mode · Category — In 1,000 related queries, 151 brands (calcium, zinc, supplement and others) appear before the item and brand-free modifiers make up 40.4% — a generic term spanning several brands

ListeningMind.AISearch Demand Report · magnesium supplement02

Market flow comparison
Compared with similar categories: did the whole market move together, or only this category?
Mineral supplements rose while sleep and stress supplements fell
Zinc (+113.2%), calcium (+130.3%) and iron (+38.8%) grew over four years, while melatonin (−27.8%) and ashwagandha (−32.7%) fell. Because the two groups move in opposite directions, the verdict changes if zinc, iron or calcium is removed.
‘magnesium supplements’ grew while the bare term ‘magnesium’ declined
‘magnesium’ still accounts for 59.6% of the last 12 months but is down −8.1% over four years and −19.3% in the last year. ‘magnesium supplements’ grew +184.3% over the same four years.
Same as marketmagnesium supplement and ashwagandha, zinc, iron, melatonin and others both grew
magnesium supplement 4-year +26.5% · similar category median +21.7% · gap +4.8%p
The supplements market is growing — 4 of 6 compared category groups grew, with a median 4-year change of +21.7%. magnesium supplement moved similarly at +26.5%, so this looks like a market trend rather than something specific to magnesium supplement.

Magnesium glycinate leads and keeps growing
‘magnesium glycinate supplements’ reached 5,058,000 searches in the last 12 months (+120.6% year on year), more than ‘magnesium supplements’ itself. ‘magnesium bisglycinate supplement’ (+118.3%) and ‘magnesium threonate supplement’ (+54.3%) also grew, while ‘magnesium citrate supplement’ fell (−16.2%).
Recommendations · beginners4 years −17.9%#1 → #3
Generic ‘best’ searches are shrinking
‘best magnesium supplements’ fell −27.1% year on year and ‘best form of magnesium supplement’ fell −45.7%, while searches naming a specific form kept growing.
Blend (complex · triple · 7-type)4 years +648.4%#7 → #7
Multi-form blends are growing fast
‘magnesium complex supplement’ reached 137,100 (+83.5%) and ‘best magnesium complex supplements’ grew +130.9%; ‘triple magnesium supplement’ also rose (+110.5%).
